h1: Custom Direct to Film Skirts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Skirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film skirts in bulk. Full-color designs with soft hand feel. Perfect for teams and events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Direct to film printing allows you to add vibrant, full-color artwork to custom skirts with a soft hand feel that won't crack or fade. Unlike screen printing, DTF works well on polyester and blended fabrics common in uniform skirts, making it ideal for sports teams, hospitality staff, and corporate events. Choose DTF for detailed logos, gradients, or photographic images that stand out on the dance floor or the sales floor.
